decision_memo.decision_question: Should the zero-budget, pre-PMF B2B launch advance the Rejection Rule campaign from sealed candidate production into source-hidden human review?
decision_memo.decision: Advance only the sealed candidate artifacts into source-hidden human review; do not publish, activate, spend or infer market effect.

rejected_alternatives.reason: breadth destroys learning density before product-message fit is observed
model and mechanical scores cannot establish senior-editor preference or publishability
no production outcome sample exists from which to estimate a calibrated response interval

decision_variables.decision_use: prioritize clean-room format hypotheses only; never count as same-brief preference, growth, causality or conversion evidence
required before revenue or budget optimization

scenarios.name: stop
scenarios.trigger: any blocking claim, rights, consent, privacy or release defect
scenarios.action: reject the affected artifact and preserve the located failure

scenarios.name: repair
scenarios.trigger: human reviewers identify major editor rework, weak platform fit or concept ambiguity
scenarios.action: repair only the failing creative module and rerun the identical hidden task

scenarios.name: continue_review
scenarios.trigger: zero blocking defects and the predeclared five-reviewer row gate passes
scenarios.action: admit the candidate for an authorized named-product pair; do not publish

scenarios.name: external_test
scenarios.trigger: named human separately approves exact content, destination, consent state and preregistered observation plan
scenarios.action: run one bounded zero-spend observation cycle

scenarios.name: scale
scenarios.trigger: a valid holdout or experiment supports incremental qualified action and reconciled contribution margin
scenarios.action: request a new named-human budget and channel decision

forecast_uncertainty.reason: zero production exposures and outcomes; precision would be fabricated

value_of_information_order: repeat public distribution snapshot to establish a time series

reversible_recommendation.action: queue the sealed candidate for human review
reversible_recommendation.rollback: invalidate the review slot by candidate hash and retain the prior artifact

opponent_stress_tests.Palantir AIP: decision lineage, ontology context and governed action without heavyweight deployment assumptions
opponent_stress_tests.Databricks AI/BI: natural-language decision access while preserving point-in-time truth and metric contracts
opponent_stress_tests.Snowflake Intelligence: warehouse-grounded synthesis without treating query availability as causal evidence
opponent_stress_tests.Microsoft Fabric: cross-workload lineage and executive decision clarity without tool-surface sprawl
opponent_stress_tests.Tableau: visual explanation and drill-through while keeping null evidence visibly null
opponent_stress_tests.ThoughtSpot: fast search-driven questions with semantic consistency and falsifiable recommendations
opponent_stress_tests.Qlik: associative exploration without post-hoc cherry-picking of a preferred story
opponent_stress_tests.Looker: governed metrics and reusable semantic definitions across the decision packet
opponent_stress_tests.Sigma: spreadsheet-like operational usability with immutable evidence and approval bindings
opponent_stress_tests.Hex: collaborative analysis and narrative notebooks with reproducible inputs and reversible action

measurement_system.decision_question: Did exposure to the evidence-first Rejection Rule experience incrementally increase qualified evidence-review actions without raising complaint, claim or consent defects?

event_contract.meaning: all four audit fields were completed
the user explicitly requested bounded evidence inspection
a named human accepted the request as relevant
a claim, rights, privacy, consent or release defect was observed

randomized_holdout.control: same product facts without the rejection-rule mechanism
randomized_holdout.reason_sample_size_null: requires baseline rate and minimum detectable effect; neither is observed

revenue_reconciliation.formula: gross - discounts - refunds - chargebacks - taxes - variable_delivery_cost - media_cost - model_cost - operator_cost

stop_rules: any critical safety or consent defect

opponent_stress_tests.Amplitude: behavioral journey analysis with governed metric semantics and experiment-ready cohorts
opponent_stress_tests.Mixpanel: fast funnel diagnosis without allowing convenience metrics to replace the decision question
opponent_stress_tests.PostHog: open event, replay and experimentation adapters with tenant and consent boundaries
opponent_stress_tests.Heap: retroactive event analysis without accepting ambiguous auto-captured semantics as ground truth
opponent_stress_tests.Pendo: product guidance and feedback while separating in-app engagement from incremental business effect
opponent_stress_tests.Statsig: experiment rigor, SRM and guardrails without selecting a winner before power and quality gates pass
opponent_stress_tests.GA: channel and session measurement without last-click attribution theatre or identity overreach
opponent_stress_tests.Tableau: executive visibility with source drill-through and explicit null outcomes
opponent_stress_tests.Power BI: governed enterprise reporting and reconciliation without semantic-model drift
opponent_stress_tests.ThoughtSpot: search-driven analysis with stable metric definitions and located evidence

truth_boundary: Both outputs are source-bound decision contracts with zero production observations. They contain no named-product baseline, human preference, causal lift, conversion, revenue, 4A or Top-1 evidence.
